category_title: Adolescent with Down's syndrome engaging in verbal outbursts
scenario_title: One-on-one instruction for writing and tracing letters
minimal_context: Dennis is sitting one-on-one with a tutor in his classroom to practice tracing and writing letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dennis, let's start your writing activity. Please trace the letters on this paper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Pick up your pencil and try the first one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish tracing these letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points across the room) He talking! That’s enough!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Dennis, let's start your writing activity. Please trace the letters on this paper.

STUDENT: (Shakes head) No.

TUTOR: Pick up your pencil and try the first one.

STUDENT: (Pushes the pencil away) Stop it.

TUTOR: We need to finish tracing these letters.

STUDENT: (Points across the room) He talking! That’s enough!
